metric_definitions.correct: answer names the expected paths (0 or 1)
metric_definitions.correct_audited: correct after the three documented grading fixes (see RESULTS.md)
metric_definitions.recall: fraction of all_of paths named (tasks with all_of only)
metric_definitions.seconds: wall seconds (includes clone and stacklit setup)
metric_definitions.total_tokens: input + output + cache creation + cache read
metric_definitions.uncached_eq_tokens: input + output + cache creation + 0.1 x cache read
